correctness.rationale: Bilateral preimages are nonempty and their free choices are the t-dimensional kernel. At time \(2^m\) the kernel comprises precisely the \(2^m\)-periodic sequences, giving full cylinder coverage iff the marked residues are distinct. Counting distinct residue classes yields the exact finite-size probability; a falling-factorial expansion proves the birthday limit under \(k^2/N\to0\). General duality characterizes unrounded hitting time by polynomial vanishing order, which for three points reduces exhaustively to pair valuations. Exact finite moment summation yields the displayed mean, second moment and variance. An independent exact Pascal-rank and enumeration checker passes all stated finite tests; it is not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact natural quantitative local-eventual-onto observable for every arbitrary finite sparse mask at dyadic times, plus its full k-site sample-space law and a genuine birthday-scale transition. The exact three-site unrounded law reveals a tight limiting distribution coexisting with mean \(\Theta(\log N)\) and variance \(\Theta(N)\), a nontrivial dynamical rare-event distinction. This is an all-size invariant with motivated finite-time interpretation, not a numerical slice or a known-table recomputation.
